posts.summary_en: Patch digest from /data/patches.json. Guild Conquest launched with the 2026-08-27 update (Brightseeker and Pinot Noir same patch). 2026-09-10 (1.3.002, Cherry Cola) fixed manual control in Guild Conquest and changed buff-conflict resolution to post-Skill-AMP value. 2026-09-23 (1.4.002, Princess Bari, Rumble Arena, Dimensional Rift) lowered GC tier thresholds, raised group medal rewards, added the Skill Prep stat and oven gear presets.

gear.substats: Oven: change presets with drawn gear; filter up to 5 sub-stats in auto bake.

mechanics: 2026-08-27: Guild Conquest: the guild fights the Extra-Stuffed Piñata. Weekly score, groups of 5 guilds, Guild Medals for the new exchange.
2026-08-27: Tea Knight Cookie (Guild Medal Exchange): every 10 s thunder strike of 155.2% ATK and all allies Boss DMG +70% for 10 s (Guild Conquest only; +45% at the lowest grade).
2026-09-10: fix: cookies could be controlled by hand in Crumble Dungeon and Guild Conquest.
2026-09-10: When buffs or debuffs conflict, the one that applies is now decided by its value after all stats are applied, Skill AMP included.
2026-09-23: new stat Skill Prep: shortens the wait for a cookie's first skill; Princess Bari and Moon Rabbit (Pampered with Persimmon) have Skill Prep 50%.
2026-09-23: Princess Bari: guided souls lose 30% damage on each repeat hit against the same enemy (100/70/49%), so her total against a single boss is lower than the raw number suggests.
2026-09-23: Dimensional Rift exchange pet/item 'Ally Boss DMG +150%' has no effect in Guild Conquest.
2026-09-23: Guild Conquest tier requirements lowered (Gold 2 1.5G -> 1.1G, Gold 3 1G -> 600M, ...).
disagreements: Patch note says the new group rewards apply 'From season 6 (Sep 24)', but crumb.gg labels the week starting 2026-09-24 as Season 5. Season numbering differs by one between the patch digest and the rankings board (possible preseason/first-week counting difference).

posts.summary_en: A Guild Conquest simulator: pick 12 cookies, 3 pets, 2 mercenary cards; it replays the fight a few hundred times on a fixed account and scores 0-100 (median and best), not raw damage. Needs sign-in; Compare, What-if, Gear and Swap finder are guild-only. No boss mechanics or formulas are published on the page.
rng: Site: 'Cookie movement can't be modelled exactly, so how often certain things happen in a fight can be off.'
Site: 'Skill Haste shifts when every skill goes off, so with different haste on your cookies the same fight can play out differently in your game.'
Site: 'Short runs are less reliable: with few fights the rare perfect run may not show up at all.'

quotes.en: Results are a value from 0 to 100, not raw damage: "typical" is the median fight, "best" the highest. The scale is stretched at the top, so losing a fifth of the damage costs about 5 points.

posts.summary_en: Generic per-cookie skill multiplier per second (MV/s) chart, 1/3/5/10 enemies, with max vs no synergies over 60 s. Single-target top: Brightseeker 7.59, Cherry Cola 6.98, Scorpion 6.39, Cool Mint 5.76, Witchberry 4.60, Melon Soda 4.08 (max synergies). Not Guild Conquest specific; ignores buffers like Pomegranate/Milk/Pinot Noir. Raw data saved as api/data-dpschart.json.
mechanics: Synergy sources listed: Projectile Speed +1 from Pomegranate; Rapid Fire +2 from Pinot Noir/Orange/Grapevine; Duration +0.75 from Milk/Coffee/Cheerleader; Chain +2 from Skating Queen/Lime.
Princess Bari guides 2 Charge allies; her souls hit with their ATK.
